requirements.rule: A percentage apprenticeship reduces every fixed allowance whose apprenticeship_pct_relevant flag the data leaves at its default, together with the base salary. Whether the CCNL applies the percentage to that allowance (an EDR, a contingenza, a function allowance) was not sourced. The run is affected when such an allowance is in the apprentice's pay.
requirements.remediation: Source, for each CCNL, the elements the apprenticeship percentage applies to and set apprenticeship_pct_relevant on every allowance; the limitation then no longer applies to its runs.

requirements.rule: Art. 68 extends parental leave to adoption and foster care, but the event records birth rather than entry into the family. Art. 79 sets the hourly quota at daily pay divided by contractual daily hours, permits administrative staff to take multiples of an hour (at least two), and operational staff half a day; the hourly event currently accepts only half-days. The top-up uses the INPS daily base (art. 23 D.Lgs. 151/2001), not an independently established collective pay base. Earlier topped-up days are supplied by the caller, not carried automatically between events.
requirements.remediation: Support the Art. 79 administrative hourly quota and adoption/foster entry dates; verify the applicable collective pay base and carry topped-up days per child across events.
